confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or price pages were inspected. Beer, coffee, and restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine are less certain and are estimated from general local price levels, not a beer-based relationship. Accommodation anchors are the least certain and may vary by season and neighbourhood; July is winter in Chile. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates page for 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized South American capitals with similar restaurant and bar price levels, such as Montevideo and Lima, adjusted for Santiago's generally higher hotel rates. No specific comparable-city dataset was used.
